pages.text:
Road clerk's copy, kept beside the waking chamber.

The workshop was our stop for road preparations: fuel, musk work, and an emergency wrap. Its work note explains the preparation. The barrow store kept a bronze ward, worth the burden of bringing home. They are separate opportunities; neither binds you to the other.

The following entries give coarse map squares and displacement from this laboratory. Use M to inspect the map; travel on foot and find an approach. Square distance is not walking time.

This is an old record of former use, not a promise of present stock or safety. Roads, inhabitants and the way inside must still be discovered.

Workshop — square (75, 100); 2 east, 1 south from the recorded laboratory (73, 99). 3 coarse squares, not walking time.
A workshop once used for road preparations: fuel, musk work and a traveller's emergency wrap. Present stock and safety are unknown.

Ward store — square (68, 98); 5 west, 1 north from the recorded laboratory (73, 99). 6 coarse squares, not walking time.
A barrow store where a bronze ward was kept. Its present contents, inhabitants and safety are unknown.
